long: Archimedean Dynasty (German: Schleichfahrt) is an underwater submarine combat simulation set in a future where humanity lives in the deep ocean. The player is a mercenary submarine pilot taking on missions through a story-driven campaign, fighting enemy subs and upgrading equipment. It launched the Aquanox series and was developed by Massive Development.
